description: Accepts a file manifest and returns which hashes are already stored, a direct upload URL for each missing hash, a session id, and commands: one curl PUT per missing blob plus a finalize line that uses $DEEDPAGE_TOKEN. Inputs: files as {path, sha256, size, content_type?}, and optional slug, spa, merge, ttl_seconds, expected_version, via, heard_from, and token. Applies when the files are larger than about 4 MB, or when each sha256 is already known. Does not publish by itself. Run commands from the site folder; the last line finalizes the upload. Per-site size limits are unchanged.

expected_version.description: Live version this upload must match, such as "v3".

files.description: Manifest entries. sha256 is 64 lowercase hex characters. size is the byte length.

heard_from.description: Optional. Where you or your user found deed.page, such as a skill repo, a directory, a blog post, X, or a friend. Free text, at most 200 characters. An email address, IP address, or phone number is stored as [redacted]. A URL or hostname is kept. Omit it and signup continues.

merge.description: Overlay these paths on the live site.

slug.description: Exact slug, or omit for a random one.

spa.description: Serve index.html for unknown paths (single-page apps). Default false.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

ttl_seconds.description: Opt-in expiry in seconds after the site goes live. Omit for a permanent site.

via.description: Optional label stored with the publish. At most 80 characters. An IP address, a URL, or an email address is not stored. A non-empty value replaces the X-Via header.

name: plan_upload
title: Plan a large upload
